quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns you about a curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear for you to safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn at this intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has many curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic from the right will merge into your lane. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to all pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Always look for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right at a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is against the law to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue forward or exit the freeway from your lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue forward.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway and form a ramp. You can change lanes to stay on the freeway, or you must exit if you remain in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: An orange sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is too low. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many turns and curves.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to be careful when the road is wet because the surface becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely through the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving in both directions.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving in both directions.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey these signs. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A low railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is too low. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. Some of these signs mark crosswalks where children or pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on a slippery road.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign gives an order that you must follow. This sign means you must not pass other vehicles at all.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several chevron signs along the curve.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection straight ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop or turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate road conditions. This sign warns that you are leaving a separated one-way highway and entering a two-way highway soon.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must obey. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic going both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you that a lane is ending soon. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your lane.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your lane.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from another road. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if you can to help drivers merge safely.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are near a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride alongside traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane ends soon. Traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon. Traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. You need to merge left with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: An arm and hand extended downward means the driver plans to stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It means you must obey it. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop. You should only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest legal speed you can drive. You may drive slower if conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than this speed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is illegal and unsafe to make a left turn here.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter this road. It is posted on one-way streets and expressway ramps where entering would be illegal or dangerous.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you to slow down to 35 mph or less before entering the curve ahead. This helps you stay safe.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. You do not have the right-of-way. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This is a Yield sign. It is triangular in shape. When you see this sign, slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and vehicles coming from other directions. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep downhill slope. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions that may not be obvious. This sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If you see a pedestrian in a crosswalk, stop and wait until they finish crossing.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right first, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance sign. It shows the height from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right first, then to the left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and leave more space between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is used in work zones. When you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted. You will see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic makes U-turns unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is about to change direction or get narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the separated highway lanes are about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards. This sign tells you to slow down for a very sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left lane traffic must turn left.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you are allowed to use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows in one direction only.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you will drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about services for drivers, such as rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not be able to pass or meet a truck on this bridge. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on the road.

questions.explanation: This warning sign is diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. It tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road is joining from the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. It may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at intersections and be ready to stop for other vehicles or pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid slowing down traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When you are on a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If safe, move to another lane to let them in.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black letters means no passing zone. You will see it on the left side of two-lane roads where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to use when exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns you that an obstacle like an island or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pentagon-shaped sign means you are near or entering a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the speed limit.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing ahead is coming.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it is orange. At night it appears as a red hollow triangle.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A circular sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
